==History==
The nation of the [[Forest Trolls]], once the core of the great [[Amani Empire]]. Zul'Aman is a great primordial forest; the main inhabitants are the [[Forest Trolls]], however several bands of [[High Elves]] also fled into the forests after the fall of [[Quel'Thalas]]. Bands of Scourge are also present, pursuing the [[High Elves]].

==Landmarks==
Major landmarks in Zul'Aman include the capital of the [[Forest Trolls]] itself, a large pyramid called the Shrine of Ula-tek. There are also the [[Maisara Hills]], home of the [[Witch Doctor]]s of the Zul'Aman, and [[Lake Abassi]] on whose shores the [[Shrine of Ula-tek]] is built.
